prd_items.note: No Content-Type added or changed and the length kept as Content-Length on both built-in adapters; the one wire exception (no Content-Length on a TinyHttpd 304) is the user's U-2 decision recorded as PRD-271.

Content-Length = argument with exactly that many bytes, early stream end aborts (ENGINE AC-6 truncated response over a real socket), -1 unknown length (ENGINE AC-4), below -1 IllegalArgumentException (FR-HTTP-037 AC-4).

Every clause of request AC-A13 is present: no Content-Type + Content-Length: 5 + 5 bytes (FR-HTTP-036 AC-1, ENGINE AC-3, SVL AC-4); HEAD and 304 with Content-Length: 5 and no body (FR-HTTP-037 AC-5 in-memory, SVL AC-4 on Jetty 9.4, ENGINE AC-5 for HEAD); 204 with neither (FR-HTTP-037 AC-6, ENGINE AC-5, SVL AC-4); -1 unknown length; -2 IllegalArgumentException; 3-byte stream aborts; no Cache-Control under defaultCache (FR-HTTP-036 AC-5). The 304 Content-Length on TinyHttpd 3.1.1 is narrowed only by the user's later answer U-2 (PRD-271), which the SRS cites.

Core commits the 304 length to the adapter (FR-HTTP-037 AC-5/AC-9); in-memory delivers it (FR-HTTP-037 AC-5); servlet adapter hands it to the container, which on Jetty 9.4.58 writes it (SVL AC-4; probe below); TinyHttpd 3.1.1 omits it (ENGINE AC-5, confirmed in ExchangeResponse.commit at e73cd5d); TinyHttpd not changed (ENGINE Rationale bullet and notes 'do not work around it'); docs state it (OPS-DX-009 AC-7).

srs_items.note: Statement carve-out 'except on a 304, where TinyHttpd 3.1.1 writes no Content-Length (PRD-271)' matches AC-5, the dated Rationale bullet and the Implementation Notes; consistent with FR-HTTP-037 AC-5 (adapter's choice) and OPS-DX-009 AC-7.

Fact check: build.gradle:365-366 pins org.eclipse.jetty 9.4.58.v20250814. Probe on that Jetty (servlet setStatus + setHeader("Content-Length","5"), the path ServletExchange.head :662-670 uses, raw socket): GET 304 -> 'HTTP/1.1 304 Not Modified ... Content-Length: 5' with no body; HEAD 200 -> 'Content-Length: 5' with no body. 204 gets no Content-Length from the core (FR-HTTP-037 AC-6), so 'neither' holds.

evidence.detail: Jetty 9.4.58 probe: HTTP/1.1 request with Host, X-A: 1, x-a: 2, X-B: 3 -> getHeaderNames() [Connection, Host, X-B, X-A, x-a]; HTTP/1.0 without Host -> [X-B, X-A, x-a], getHeaders("X-A") [1, 2].

findings.description: AC-1 'headerNames() equal to [x-a, x-b]': over HTTP/1.1 the names also include host (the SharedApp.http harness adds Host), and Jetty iterates x-b before x-a.
